description: This file defines an abstract generic class `ExtendedListAdapter` for handling RecyclerView adapters with selection capabilities, state restoration, and event listeners within an Android app. It also declares an interface `SelectableViewHolder` for view holders that support selection state updates, and an extension property on `BaseFragment` to handle back presses with list selections.

classes.name: SelectableViewHolder
classes.description: An interface for RecyclerView ViewHolders that can update their selection status.

classes.name: ExtendedListAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class extending ListAdapter with support for item selection, state saving/restoration, and change listeners.

methods.name: enableSelection
methods.description: Enables selection mode for the adapter, restoring saved selection state and setting up listeners.

methods.name: setOnListChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked when the list of items changes.

methods.name: getItemAtPosition
methods.description: Returns the item at a given position.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of currently selected items.

methods.name: toggleSelectionForItem
methods.description: Toggles the selection state for the given item ID.

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Selects all items in the list.

methods.name: getPositionById
methods.description: Finds the position of an item with the given ID.

methods.name: onItemSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the visual selection state of a ViewHolder for a given item ID.

methods.name: saveSelectedIds
methods.description: Saves the current selection IDs to the SavedStateRegistry.

methods.name: updateSelectedIds
methods.description: Updates internal selection state based on list changes.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Handles logic when the selection state changes, including saving state and invoking callback.

methods.name: onCurrentListChanged
methods.description: Overrides ListAdapter's callback to update selection IDs and notify about list changes.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds view holder and updates selection status if selection is enabled.

methods.name: onAttachedToRecyclerView
methods.description: Stores a reference to the RecyclerView when attached.

methods.name: releaseReferences
methods.description: Releases references to views and callbacks during cleanup.
